# Federico Molinari

Federico Molinari is an Argentine artistic gymnast who has been one of the most prominent figures in Argentine gymnastics. Here is what I know about him:

## Personal Background
- **Nationality:** Argentine
- He was born in Argentina and became one of the country's most accomplished gymnasts.

## Career Highlights

### Olympic Games
- Molinari represented Argentina at the Olympic Games. He notably competed at the **2008 Beijing Olympics** and the **2012 London Olympics**.
- He was one of the few Argentine gymnasts to qualify for the Olympics in artistic gymnastics, which was a significant achievement for a country not traditionally considered a gymnastics powerhouse.

### Specialty
- He was particularly known as a **rings** specialist, though he also competed in other apparatus events and in the all-around.

### Pan American Games & South American Championships
- Molinari was a dominant force in regional competitions, winning multiple medals at the **Pan American Games** and **South American Championships**.
- He helped raise the profile of gymnastics in Argentina through his consistent international performances.

### World Championships
- He competed at multiple **FIG World Championships**, representing Argentina on the global stage.

## Legacy
Molinari is widely regarded as one of the best gymnasts in Argentine history. His success helped inspire greater interest in artistic gymnastics in Argentina and across South America.

If you're looking for very specific statistics or detailed competition results, I'd recommend checking the FIG (Fédération Internationale de Gymnastique) database or Argentine gymnastics federation records, as my information may not capture every detail of his career.
